- File: scripts/security_audit.sh
  Location: lines 1305-1308 (the `security_audit_claude_rc -ne 0` branch)
  Issue: When Claude exits nonzero, the captured stderr in CODEX_ERROR_FILE is not surfaced via a path diagnostic before the failure is emitted, making a Claude crash harder to triage than a codex crash which goes through the existing sanitized-stderr-tail path.
  Suggested minimal fix: Call `security_audit_emit_path_diagnostic "${CODEX_ERROR_FILE}"` before `security_audit_emit_failure "claude-execution" ...` so the error report carries the captured Claude stderr.
